models.poisson_weather_forecast: Poisson GLM baseline + Open-Meteo previous_day2 forecasts: temperature, temperature^2, wind speed, wet (precipitation >= 0.1 mm); refit monthly
models.sarimax_weather_forecast: SARIMAX + weekly calendar + the same four Open-Meteo previous_day2 forecast regressors; estimated 2024-02-01..2025-12-31

selection_evidence: 2025 validation: Poisson RMSE 6.12 -> 5.84 pickups, 5.99 -> 5.71 drop-offs (DM p 0.0008 / 0.0013); SARIMAX 6.27 -> 6.05, 6.21 -> 5.99 (DM p < 0.0001)
regime: daily_updated: day-ahead from New York midnight, trips known through the previous day
